summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Treesh 3.0 single-file music app. PRIMARY BUG FIXED: Instrum controls no longer overflow at Large or Medium text sizes. Successfully tested 5 of 6 Phase 1 regressions with all passing. Minor issues with complex UI interactions (lyric editing, This or That game completion) due to animation/overlay timing.

integration_issues.flow: This or That game - Champion screen
integration_issues.issue: Unable to complete multiple picks to reach champion screen. After first pick, second click fails due to element interception by animation overlay (tot-stage element blocks pointer events during transition)
integration_issues.notes: Game starts correctly, first pick works, but subsequent picks blocked by animation timing. May need longer wait times or force clicks.

integration_issues.issue: Unable to reliably expand mini player to full-screen mode for lyric editing test. Expand button not consistently visible or clickable
integration_issues.notes: Mini player appears correctly when song plays, but expansion mechanism unclear from automated testing perspective.

integration_issues.issue: On mobile viewport (390x844), Instrum navigation button found but not visible/clickable. May be hidden behind overlay or require mobile menu interaction
integration_issues.notes: Desktop navigation works perfectly. Mobile has bottom nav bar visible but interaction blocked.
